dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いいたします。)
dialogue.English: (I look forward to speaking with you.)

dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いいたします。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for having me.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。来ていただき、ありがとうございます。最初に、年齢・性別・ご相談内容を教えていただけますか?
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a counselor here. Thank you for coming. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 35歳　女性仕事の相談です
dialogue.English: I'm 35, female, and I'd like to talk about work.

dialogue.content: お仕事のことで悩んでいらっしゃるのですね。具体的には、どのようなことでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see, you're having some trouble with work. Could you tell me more specifically what's going on?

dialogue.content: 仕事の元同僚から、嫌がらせのような嫌味のようなことをずっと言われています。
dialogue.English: I've been constantly receiving harassing and snide remarks from a former coworker.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。嫌な気分になりますよね。どのような場面で言われるのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. That must feel awful. In what situations does this happen?

dialogue.content: 前の職場なので、私は元同僚が原因で、仕事を辞めました。
dialogue.English: It happened at my previous job. I actually quit because of that former colleague.

dialogue.content: 前の職場の、友達にまだ私のことを色々言っているようです。
dialogue.English: It seems she's still saying all sorts of things about me to friends at my old workplace.

dialogue.content: 私とプライベートで会ったことも、悪く言われたみたいです。
dialogue.English: Apparently, she even bad-mouthed the fact that I met up with them privately.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。そのことで辞めてしまわれて。
dialogue.English: I see. So that's why you ended up quitting.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、元同僚の方は、男性ですか?女性ですか?
dialogue.English: By the way, is this former coworker male or female?

dialogue.content: 女性です。
dialogue.English: She's a woman.

dialogue.content: 辞めた後も、いろいろ言われるのは悔しい思いがあるでしょうね。今、どのようなお気持ちですか?
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating to have things said about you even after you've left. How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.content: 一言でいうと悔しいですね、、
dialogue.English: In a word, I'm frustrated...

dialogue.content: 一生懸命私なりに努力して積み上げたものを捨てることになりましたから。
dialogue.English: Because I had to throw away what I had built up through my own hard work.

dialogue.content: きっと、私が目立っているように感じていたんだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think she probably felt that I was standing out too much.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。嫉妬していたのでしょうか。辞めたのは大きな決心でしたね。お仕事は何年くらいお勤めだったのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. Perhaps she was jealous. It must have been a big decision to quit. How many years were you at that job?

dialogue.content: ７年目でした。周りの人達は嫉妬、ひがみだと言う人もいました、、
dialogue.English: It was my seventh year. Some people around me also said it was jealousy and envy...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。それほど長く積み上げてきたキャリアを捨てるのは、勇気がいったでしょうね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must have taken a lot of courage to leave behind a career you had built up for so long.

dialogue.content: 辞めるのは、本当に苦しかったです。
dialogue.English: Quitting was truly painful.

dialogue.content: でも、続ける意味も見失ってしまいました。
dialogue.English: But I had also lost any reason to continue.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。毎日のように嫌がらせを受けていたら、心身ともにおかしくなってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. If you were being harassed like that every day, it would be bound to take a toll on you, both mentally and physically.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、言葉でコントロールしてこようとしていたので、
dialogue.English: That's right... She was trying to control me with her words,

dialogue.content: ◯◯ちゃんは優しいから、とかきっとわかってると思うけど、、とか
dialogue.English: saying things like, "You're so kind, so..." or "I'm sure you understand, but..."

dialogue.content: しないと思ってるから、とか
dialogue.English: or "I know you wouldn't do that..."

dialogue.content: 前置きしてから、言ってくるんです。
dialogue.English: She would use phrases like that as a preface before saying what she wanted.

dialogue.content: ひどいこともたくさん言われて
dialogue.English: She said many terrible things to me,

dialogue.content: なんていうか、、
dialogue.English: How should I put it...

dialogue.content: そんなことが…。それはひどいですよね。心が折れてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That's terrible. It's enough to break anyone's spirit.

dialogue.content: 人ってみんな黒いところあると思うんですけど、
dialogue.English: I think everyone has a dark side, but...

dialogue.content: それでも、口に出さないことってありますよね
dialogue.English: there are still things you just don't say out loud, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね。いろいろな思いがあっても、心に収めておきますよね。
dialogue.English: That's true. Even if we have various thoughts, we keep them to ourselves.

dialogue.content: その黒いところをポロっとひとりごとのように聞こえるようにつぶやくんですよ
dialogue.English: She would mutter those dark things under her breath, just loud enough for me to hear, as if she were talking to herself.

dialogue.content: それに疲れました、、
dialogue.English: I got so tired of it...

dialogue.content: 聞こえるように…。ひとりごとじゃないですよね。そんなことをされたら、仕事どころじゃないですよね。
dialogue.English: Loud enough to be heard... That's not really talking to herself, is it? If someone did that to you, you wouldn't be able to focus on your work at all.

dialogue.content: 仕事行くのが嫌になりました。笑えなくなりました。
dialogue.English: I started to hate going to work. I couldn't smile anymore.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。笑えないのはお辛いですよね。でも、相談者様が辞めた後も、相手の方が悪口を言っているのは、どういうお気持ちなんでしょうね?
dialogue.English: I see. It must be painful not to be able to smile. But I wonder why she's still bad-mouthing you even after you've left.

dialogue.content: 辞めたあとでも、私と仲良くしているのが気に入らないみたいなんです。
dialogue.English: It seems she doesn't like that people are still friendly with me, even after I've left.

dialogue.content: 友達に仕事でも友達としても選んでもらえないって言ったらしく
dialogue.English: Apparently, she told a mutual friend that she feels like she's not being chosen, either as a colleague or as a friend.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私と付き合うことに嫉妬ですかねー
dialogue.English: I guess she's jealous of them associating with me.

dialogue.content: あとは、SNSの過去の投稿で私が写っているところを削除されたり
dialogue.English: Also, she deleted past social media posts that I was in.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。とても根深い方のようですね。
dialogue.English: I see. She sounds like a person with very deep-seated issues.

dialogue.content: いなかったことにされてます
dialogue.English: It's like I've been erased.

dialogue.content: ここまでされると、怖い気持ちもあります。
dialogue.English: When it goes this far, I also feel scared.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。ちょっと病的なものを感じますよね。
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It does feel a bit pathological, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: やはり、そうですよね。私恨まれることはしてないですし、勝手にそう解釈していると思うんですよね。
dialogue.English: Right, that's what I thought. I haven't done anything to deserve her resentment; I think she's just interpreting things however she wants.

dialogue.content: その人、発達障害グレーゾーンだからって言ってたんです。
dialogue.English: She used to say it's because she's in the gray zone for a developmental disorder.

dialogue.content: いつも、私はグレーだからって
dialogue.English: She would always say, "It's because I'm in the gray zone..."

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。ご自身でも自覚があったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So she had some self-awareness about that.

dialogue.content: 人の気持ちわからなくて怒らせるし、衝動的だしって
dialogue.English: She'd say things like she doesn't understand people's feelings and makes them angry, and that she's impulsive.

dialogue.content: ご自身でも分かっている部分はあるのですね。
dialogue.English: So there are aspects that she understands about herself.

dialogue.content: でも、だんだん意図的に言ってきているんじゃないか？って疑うことも出てきて
dialogue.English: But gradually, I started to suspect that she might be saying these things intentionally.

dialogue.content: 何か嫌味を言った後、こちらの反応見てニヤリとするんです
dialogue.English: After making some snide remark, she would look at my reaction and smirk.

dialogue.content: 気持ち悪くないですか？
dialogue.English: Isn't that creepy?

dialogue.content: 何だか、とても嫌な性格の方のようですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like she's a very unpleasant person.

dialogue.content: もう、ほんとに、、そう思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I really do... That's exactly how I feel.

dialogue.content: 相談者様がそのターゲットにされてしまった感じでしょうか?
dialogue.English: Does it feel like you were targeted by her?

dialogue.content: 他の人に対しては、どうだったのでしょう?
dialogue.English: How was she with other people?

dialogue.content: ターゲットになったんでしょうね。最初は◯◯ちゃんみたいにできたら〜とかすごい好きだとか言ってたんですけど、、嫉妬にかわったようですね、、上司とかにすがるのが上手で私はできない子、不器用な子って、アピールして可哀想な子を、演じてるんですよね。
dialogue.English: I suppose I became the target. At first, she would say things like, "I wish I could be like you," or "I really like you," but it seems to have turned into jealousy. She's good at clinging to superiors, appealing to them that she's incapable and clumsy, playing the victim.

dialogue.content: だから、上からは良い子、頑張る子に見えてるんじゃないてますかね、、
dialogue.English: So to her superiors, she probably looks like a good, hard-working person...

dialogue.content: 大変な方が同僚だったのですね。それでは毎日仕事に行くのが嫌になりますよね。
dialogue.English: That was a very difficult person to have as a colleague. No wonder it made you hate going to work each day.

dialogue.content: 上の人には媚びて、自分より下と思う人やコントロールできなかった人にはひどい対応なので、嫌いな人が多いです。
dialogue.English: She fawns over her superiors but treats people she thinks are beneath her or that she can't control horribly, so a lot of people dislike her.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。他の人にも同じような態度なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So she acts that way toward other people as well.

dialogue.content: その人に関わりたくないから仕事辞めたのに
dialogue.English: I quit my job specifically because I didn't want to have anything to do with her, and yet...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: いまだに言われるってなんなんでしょう？
dialogue.English: So why is she still talking about me, even now?

dialogue.content: このまま我慢するしかないんですかね？
dialogue.English: Do I just have to keep putting up with it?

dialogue.content: 気分は良くないですよね。でも、そのまま仕事を続けていたら、相談者様の心が壊れていたかもしれませんね。離れて正解だったのでしょうね。
dialogue.English: It doesn't feel good, does it? But if you had stayed at that job, your spirit might have been broken. It was probably the right decision to leave.

dialogue.content: 正解だったと思います。そう思いたいです。
dialogue.English: I think it was the right decision. I want to believe that.

dialogue.content: いつまで、言われ続けるのかと思うとしんどいです、、
dialogue.English: It's exhausting to think about how long she'll keep talking about me.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。筋金入りのしつこさかもしれませんよね。我慢…、というより、まだ懲りずにやっているんだなぁ、と遠くから見ていれば良いのでは?
dialogue.English: I understand. Her persistence might be deeply ingrained. Rather than "enduring" it, perhaps you could try to view it from a distance, thinking, "Oh, she's still at it, not having learned a thing."

dialogue.content: 簡単ではありませんが。
dialogue.English: I know that's not easy, though.

dialogue.content: そうですね、気にしないようにしてたんですが、私とプライベートで会うことさえもとやかく言われると、友達にも迷惑かかるから誘いにくいですし、、
dialogue.English: You're right. I've been trying not to let it bother me, but when she even criticizes my friends for meeting with me privately, it makes it hard to invite them out because I don't want to cause them trouble...

dialogue.content: なんで私が我慢しなきゃいえないの？と怒りも湧いてきます
dialogue.English: And I feel a surge of anger, thinking, "Why do I have to be the one to put up with this?"

dialogue.content: そうですよね。悔しさと怒りと。相手の方は、相談者様と離れてもなお、相談者様をコントロールしようとしているのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: I understand. That frustration and anger. Even though you're no longer there, she might still be trying to control you.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そういうことも考えられるのですね、、直接言ってやりたいですが、、被害者意識がとても強いひとだから、また何を言われるかと思うと現実的ではないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see... that's a possibility. I'd love to tell her off directly, but she has such a strong victim mentality, so it's not realistic when I think about what she might say in retaliation.

dialogue.content: そのように思われます。お友達もいろいろ言われて大変だと思いますが、相談者様とあっていることは、内緒にしていては?
dialogue.English: I would agree. I'm sure it's difficult for your friends to be told all those things, but perhaps they could keep your meetings with them private?

dialogue.content: 言わないはずだったのですが、、今回はバレたんですよね。
dialogue.English: We weren't supposed to say anything, but this time the secret got out.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どこからバレるかわからないから、、それも怖いですよね
dialogue.English: Not knowing how the information gets out... that's scary too.

dialogue.content: そうですね。不思議ですね。大切な相談相手のお友達とのお付き合いは、続けた方が良いかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: It is strange, isn't it? It might be best to continue your relationships with those friends, who are an important source of support for you.

dialogue.content: お友達もこれからも変わらないといってくれてるので、ありがたいです。
dialogue.English: My friends have told me that nothing will change between us, so I'm very grateful for that.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。良かったですね。ちなみに、相談者様は、今は別のお仕事をされているのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. That's wonderful to hear. By the way, are you working at a different job now?

dialogue.content: はい、別のところに再就職しました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I've started a new job at a different company.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。職場の雰囲気はどうですか?
dialogue.English: I see. How is the atmosphere at your new workplace?

dialogue.content: そうですね、悪くはないと思いますがまだ誰を信じて良いか、、怖いと思うがあって。
dialogue.English: Well, it's not bad, but I still feel a sense of fear... like I don't know who I can trust yet.

dialogue.content: 思う気持ちがあってです。
dialogue.English: That's the feeling I have.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。あんなことがあった後ですから、無理もありません。
dialogue.English: Of course. After what you went through, that's completely understandable.

dialogue.content: でも、ほっとしました。少しずつ、周囲に打ち解けていけたらいいですね。
dialogue.English: But I'm relieved to hear that. I hope you can gradually open up to the people around you.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですね。自分を出すのはなかなか難しいですが、少しずつ慎重にやっていこうと思ってます。
dialogue.English: Yes, you're right. It's quite difficult to be my true self, but I plan to take it slowly and carefully.

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えなのですね。前職でお辛い思いをされたのに、こうやって頑張っていらっしゃって。すごいことですよね。
dialogue.English: I see that's how you're approaching it. Despite the painful experience at your previous job, you're still trying so hard. That's truly amazing.

dialogue.content: そうですかね、、
dialogue.English: Do you think so...?

dialogue.content: なるべく前を向いて、コントロールされていないことに、幸せなお気持ちでいられたらいいですよね。
dialogue.English: It would be wonderful if you could look forward and feel happy that you're no longer being controlled.

dialogue.content: そうですね。私は私って、思たら良いんでしょうけど。悔しい気持ちがいつまでも残ってしまって。
dialogue.English: That's true. I know I should just think, "I am who I am," but this feeling of frustration just won't go away.

dialogue.content: 自分が幸せになれることだけ探して頑張ります
dialogue.English: I'll do my best to just focus on finding things that will make me happy.

dialogue.content: そのように思われるのですね。素敵ですね。思い出してイライラした時は、好きな音楽を聴きながら、好みの飲み物でも飲んで、リラックスタイムを楽しんでもいいと思います。
dialogue.English: That's a wonderful way to think about it. It's lovely. When you find yourself remembering and feeling irritated, I think it's a good idea to listen to your favorite music, have a drink you like, and enjoy some time to relax.

dialogue.content: そうですね。自分のためにご褒美してみます
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll try to give myself a little treat.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。また、何かありましたら、いつでもお話しにいらして下さい。
dialogue.English: That's right. If anything else comes up, please feel free to come and talk anytime.

dialogue.content: お時間になってしまいました。これで終了とさせて頂いてもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is up. Would it be alright to conclude our session here?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。お話できてスッキリできたのでまた明日から頑張ります。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. I feel much better after talking about this, so I'll do my best again starting tomorrow.

dialogue.content: またよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.content: 良かったです。こちらこそお話して下さり、ありがとうございました。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. Thank you for sharing your story with me. I look forward to our next session.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well.)
